_comment: Copy this file before a real run. It is a configuration template and dry-run input; use run-screening.sh directly for real Standalone submissions. Cluster A is worker1 HotSpot/G1. Cluster B is worker2 Semeru/OpenJ9 Balanced with persistent SCC; use standalone_pool 'openj9', gc 'balanced', cores=2, and instances=3. The submit script, not worker Pod environment variables, owns driver/executor JVM tuning.

experiments._comment: Do not treat worker1 G1 and worker2 OpenJ9 as a same-node performance baseline. Verify actual executor JVM identity and driver placement from master/worker logs.
